meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能在真正的浏览器里做事情：打开网页、点击按钮、填写表格、截图、抓取网页里的内容。网页会一直开着，方便接着做下一步。
howto.when: 当你说“打开某网址”、“点击某元素”、“填写表单”等，或要求执行其他浏览器操作时触发。

say.note: Claude 会打开这个网址并截图给你。

say.text: 把登录表单填好并提交。
say.note: Claude 会定位表单并替你填写提交。

say.text: 在刚才打开的页面上点击“加入购物车”。
say.note: 页面状态还在，可以接着操作。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can operate a real browser to open sites, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, and extract page data. Pages stay open between steps so Claude can continue where it left off.
howto.when_en: It activates when you ask to open a specific webpage, click an element, fill out a form, or perform other browser actions.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will open the URL and send you a screenshot.

say_en.text: Fill out the login form and submit it.
say_en.note: Claude will locate the form, enter the info, and submit.

say_en.text: On the page that's still open, click 'Add to cart'.
say_en.note: The page stays open, so Claude can keep working.
